wording_qualifications.text: Bare plural books satisfies the determination requirement that bare singular book fails.
wording_qualifications.assessment: Correct status, but the phrasing can imply that plural books is subject to the singular-count determination requirement. More precisely, plural books is not subject to that same requirement. The source itself uses the shorthand that Books arrived passes.

wording_qualifications.text: the relevant target restriction on the is only that the nominal it determines may itself be headed by an independent determinative
wording_qualifications.assessment: This describes a permission as a restriction. A determinative-headed nominal is permitted as a target, not required. P01 correctly records no count or number restriction, so this is an explanatory wording issue.
